messages:
anya (Docs): Opening a short PR to add a migration note for the new retention API, tighten SOC 2 language around audit logs, and include a Python SDK snippet + link fixes. Need legal + security review before merging.

mike (Security): Thanks. Important: don't promise fixed retention as a public guarantee. Use 'recommended' or 'typical' and say contractual SLAs may differ. Also add that logs are kept in append-only stores with integrity checks and that deletions are logged and require approval.

daphne (Legal): Agreed. Add a line that retention may be extended for regulatory or legal holds. Also, for the migration note, avoid prescriptive wording that implies customers can force us to delete data outside contract terms.

anya (Docs): Draft migration blurb I'll add: 
```
Migration note: We recently replaced the legacy retention endpoints with the new Retention API (v2). Recommended default windows are 90 days (development) and 24 months (production). Actual retention is configurable by customers and may be extended to satisfy legal or contractual obligations. For private deployments, customers control retention via the console or API.
```

noah (DevEx): Can we show a short Python snippet for attaching audit metadata and a small migration curl example showing the v1 -> v2 payload transform? Folks rely on examples.

anya (Docs): Adding Python SDK snippet for audit correlation: 
```py
# attach audit metadata for traceability
resp = client.responses.create(
    model='rw-instruct-1',
    input='Summarize',
    headers={'x-redwood-audit-id': 'org-111-event-2026'}
)
```

anya (Docs): And a tiny curl migration example: 
```bash
# v1 (legacy)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/retention -d '{"days":365}'
# v2 (new)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/retention -d '{"policy_name":"prod-default","retention_days":365}'
```

ravi (Infra): Add a sample retention policy payload showing redaction options for Dedicated/Private: 
```json
{
  "policy_name": "prod-default",
  "retention_days": 730,
  "redaction": {"pii_fields":["email","credit_card"], "method":"tokenize"}
}
```

mike (Security): Also include a single-sentence security note: "Audit logs are stored in append-only storage with integrity monitoring; deletions are logged and require authorization."

daphne (Legal): One more: change 'we retain' to 'Redwood retains' and label numbers as 'recommended' in the copy. Also add: 'Customer contracts and applicable law may override these recommendations.'

anya (Docs): Will update wording: "Recommended retention: 90 days (dev), 24 months (prod). Redwood retains audit logs to support investigations, compliance, and contract obligations. Actual retention is configurable and subject to customer agreements and law. Audit logs are stored append-only with integrity monitoring; deletions are logged and require authorization."

ci-bot: docs CI queued: build \u2705, staging \u2705

anya (Docs): Thanks everyone 64f I'll update the PR with the Python snippet, curl migration example, infra payload, and the wording changes. Merging after final legal sign-off and a quick security pass.
